name: Boat Pose
description: Balance on the sit bones with the legs lifted and the torso leaning back, making a V shape.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Sit with your knees bent and feet flat, hands lightly behind your thighs.
Lean back a little until you balance just behind your sit bones, then lift your feet.

keyframes.name: Sit in Staff Pose
keyframes.cue: Sit tall with the legs straight out in front.

keyframes.name: Boat Pose
keyframes.cue: Lean back, lift the legs, reach the arms forward.

cues: Keep the chest lifted and the spine long.
Bend the knees if the back rounds.
